$meta.description: Raw design token extraction from Figma. Source of truth for scripts/build-theme.mjs, which generates src/themes/valiify.css from this file.
$meta.extractedVia: Figma Plugin API via use_figma (figma.variables.getLocalVariableCollectionsAsync — the COMPLETE local set, applied or not) + get_variable_defs sweeps for typography and effects

extractedFrom.name: Components (section) — full subtree sweep, plus per-frame sweeps of every component set inside it (fields incl. Error variants, Radio, Checkbox, iconbutton, Switch, Disclaimer, Header, List Item, Select Card, Badge, Box, Skeleton, Owner Container)
Portal Specific (section) — Buttons, Application Status, Action
Local variable collection 'Collection 1' (Mode 1) — all 77 variables enumerated via the Plugin API, 2026-09-02

$meta.status: COMPLETE variable enumeration. 56 colors / 13 spacing / 8 radius from the local collection via the Plugin API; 24 text styles from the type-preview + component sweeps; 1 effect (Primary Ring). The earlier applied-only sweep had missed 26 unapplied colors (the entire Error and Info ramps, the Success/Warning/Neutral tint sets, BG/Page and BG/Card) plus ALL spacing and radius variables.
limitations: get_variable_defs returns only variables APPLIED to a layer — the applied-only sweep missed 26 of 56 colors and all spacing/radius variables. The Plugin API enumeration (use_figma -> figma.variables.getLocalVariableCollectionsAsync) is the authoritative completeness source; re-run it when the designer adds tokens.
search_design_system indexes published LIBRARIES, not this file's local collection, and returns names without values — not useful for this file's token audit.

DUPLICATE NAMES SILENTLY DROP STYLES in get_variable_defs' keyed response. The Plugin API enumeration does not have this problem; typography (which still comes from get_variable_defs) keeps the textKey collision guard as backstop.
resolved: lineHeight: UNLIKE the dashboard file, this file authors explicit px line heights on nearly every style (e.g. 28/34, 15/20). The API's Auto sentinel 100 appears only on Labels, links & UI/Link — recorded as the string "AUTO" and emitted as line-height: normal.

letterSpacing: EVERY value this API returns is a PERCENTAGE, not px (dashboard-verified reading). Stored as letterSpacingPercent and emitted as em: 10 -> 0.1em, 8 -> 0.08em, 16 -> 0.16em, 5 -> 0.05em.

Figma group 'Text' maps to the public prefix 'content' and 'BG' to 'surface' (COLOR_GROUPS in the generator) — avoids text-text-* / bg-bg-* utilities and matches the dashboard library's public API shape.
'Base' is treated as a ramp's main shade (Neutral/Base -> --color-neutral), same as 'Main' and the group-named form (Primary/Primary -> --color-primary).
Spacing: 13 whole-px variables (2..64) exist and ALL map exactly to Tailwind native steps (2 -> p-0.5 ... 64 -> p-16), so no --spacing-* tokens are emitted, same rule as the dashboard.
openQuestions: CASING, PARTIALLY RESOLVED (Button extraction, 2026-09-02): Button Label and Micro-Label carry a REAL uppercase transform — the Button set types its samples 'Button' mixed-case and styles them uppercase (structure lane read the transform, visual lane confirmed the caps render; Bubble, bound to Labels/Default, renders mixed-case with no transform). Both styles now carry textTransform:true and emit type-button-label / type-micro-label utilities. STILL OPEN for Eyebrow, Data Key, Tag & Pill, and the Lockup styles — resolve per component the same way.

ERROR BINDING SLIP (upgraded from open question): a full Error ramp EXISTS (#c0362c with Text/BG/Ring/Stroke/Stroke-Hover) but is applied nowhere — the field components' Error=Yes variants bind Warning/Base instead. Now clearly an authoring slip to raise with the designer; implement error states against the Error ramp only after they confirm.
Action/Pressed and Action/Active are distinct variables with the identical value #1a1a1a14 — possibly one is legacy. Both extracted.

Success/Base and Success/Text are distinct variables with the identical value #2e6e4e. Both extracted (the dashboard's Approved ramp split the same way with different values, so this may diverge later).
Primary/Primary and Primary/Text are distinct variables with the identical value #a6192e. Both extracted.

Radius/xl (10px) and Radius/2xl (12px) deliberately override Tailwind v4's defaults (12px/16px) in the emitted theme; xs/sm/md/lg are byte-identical to Tailwind's so those are no-ops. Radius/none and Radius/full are not emitted (native rounded-none / rounded-full already match).
All 77 variables carry scope ALL_SCOPES — no scoping discipline in the file yet; harmless for CSS emission.
